name: Uranium Energy Corp.
blurb: Uranium Energy Corp. is a US-based uranium mining and development company focused on low-cost, environmentally friendly In Situ Recovery (ISR) extraction technology. The company holds a diversified portfolio of projects across Wyoming, Texas, New Mexico, and Arizona in the United States, as well as assets in Canada and Paraguay. With a market capitalization of approximately $7.6 billion, UEC is one of the larger pure-play uranium producers publicly traded in North America. The company currently operates at a net loss, reflecting the capital-intensive nature of uranium development and production ramp-up.
